method.cer: NFC, remove all Unicode whitespace, preserve case/digits/punctuation
method.latency: monotonic wall time including subprocess launch, model load, TSV
method.rss: GNU time maximum RSS of process; excludes app/rasterizer
method.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), includes failed elapsed times
method.profiles: source image downscale caps; never upscale; unknown original DPI
method.cache: new process per run; OS file cache not flushed
method.scope: 30 block/derived samples, not 30 independent pages; no holdout

manifest.license: research-only; no dataset images or text redistributed
manifest.selection: round-robin source order, first 10 eligible prose blocks per language
